messages.cli.memo.arg.memo: Letter id, e.g. m_20261112_4k2pqz (elvaria memo list prints them).
messages.cli.memo.decision.delivered: Read by the quests it went to
messages.cli.memo.decision.lapsed: Lapsed: the quests it went to finished or left before reading it
messages.cli.memo.none_open: No open letters (elvaria memo list --all shows the decided ones too).
messages.cli.memo.list.summary: List the letters characters wrote about work outside their quests (memos), the open ones unless --all.
messages.cli.memo.list.option.all: Also list the letters already decided.
messages.cli.memo.show.summary: Show one letter: who wrote it on which quest, where it went, how it was decided, and its whole text.
messages.cli.memo.show.hint: Decide it: elvaria memo decide {id} shelved (or rejected), or elvaria memo decide {id} handled --quest <quest>; or let the Chancellor draft a quest from it: elvaria say --memo {id}
messages.cli.memo.show.hint_quests: Nobody decides this letter: each quest it went to reads it once, in the next session of its assignee, and the Steward closes it then.
messages.cli.memo.field.author: Author
messages.cli.memo.refusal.no_verdict: its run came back with no fail to contest
messages.cli.memo.refusal.owner_verdict: the verdict is your own return
messages.cli.memo.refusal.final_verdict: the verdict is a second judge's, and final
messages.cli.memo.refusal.second_objection: another objection contests that verdict already
messages.cli.memo.refusal.no_author: no character wrote the quest: you or the machine did, or its mage is gone
messages.cli.memo.refusal.below_rank: the quest is below the rank amendments go to their author from (kingdom.dispatch.amendments.from_rank)
messages.cli.memo.refusal.second_amendment: the quest had an amendment already
messages.cli.memo.decide.summary: Decide a letter once: set it aside (shelved), refuse it (rejected), or name the quest that does the work (handled --quest); no quest changes, except the one waiting on the amendment you decide (accepted or rejected), which goes on with your note as the answer (decide_memo command).
messages.cli.memo.decide.arg.decision: shelved, rejected, handled, or accepted (an amendment only).
messages.cli.memo.decide.option.quest: With handled: the quest that does the work.
messages.cli.memo.decide.option.note: A note kept with the decision; one that names another letter's id is refused.
messages.cli.memo.decide.bad_decision: "{decision}" is no decision: give one of {decisions}.
messages.cli.memo.decide.needs_quest: A handled letter names the quest that does the work: --quest <quest>.
messages.cli.memo.decide.closed: Letter {id} is decided already: a letter is decided once.
messages.cli.memo.decide.note_names_other: The note names letter {other}, but you are deciding letter {id}: a note goes with the letter it decides. Check the letter id, or take the other id out of the note.
